messages.message: Our alliance remains my highest priority. I have fully vacated Munich to ensure your security and trust. I am currently managing a volatile situation in the Balkans with Turkey and keeping a close eye on Italy. I trust you will continue to press your advantage in the West; as long as our northern border is secure, I can focus entirely on neutralizing the southern threats.

The non-aggression pact we established has been mutually beneficial and has provided much-needed stability. As we enter Spring 1906, I propose we extend this NAP through the Autumn phase. I have no desire to contest your positions in the east while Turkey remains aggressive in the Balkans. Do we have an agreement to maintain the peace?

The positioning of your fleet in Rumania is highly provocative and threatens the stability of the region. I would prefer to avoid a conflict that would only serve to benefit Italy or Russia. I am open to discussing a sustainable division of influence in the Balkans, provided your units move to less threatening positions.

I am well aware of your movements in the Adriatic. I suggest you reconsider any plans for expansion northward, as I am fully prepared to defend my borders and pressure your coast should you choose to escalate.

To Russia,

The situation in the West is becoming increasingly dangerous. France and Germany are consolidating their positions, and England is fighting for survival on two fronts. I acknowledge our previous attempts at cooperation against Germany did not yield results, and I understand your current strategic priorities. However, the unchecked aggression of France and Germany poses a long-term threat to the stability of the entire continent. France, in particular, has shown a blatant disregard for agreements. I believe it is crucial for us to at least maintain open communication and perhaps explore a defensive understanding, especially concerning German movements. England is willing to discuss any avenue that might prevent a complete continental collapse.
- England

To Austria,

I hope this message finds you well. England is currently engaged in a desperate struggle for survival against the combined aggression of France and Germany. France has demonstrated a clear pattern of betrayal and expansion, most recently seizing London in violation of a truce. This unchecked aggression poses a significant threat to the stability of the entire region. I wanted to share my concerns and understand your perspective on the current balance of power and the potential implications of France's actions.
- England

To Italy,

Greetings. England is in a dire situation, facing a relentless assault from both France and Germany. France has proven to be an exceptionally untrustworthy and aggressive power, recently violating a truce to seize London. This kind of behavior destabilizes the entire continent and poses a threat to all nations. I wanted to reach out and share my concerns regarding France's aggressive expansion and the general instability it is creating.
- England
Italy, our alliance remains vital. France will focus on crushing Germany; you secure the Mediterranean. No moves against each other. Austria/Turkey must stay neutral. Confirm your stance.
Germany, your hold on Belgium and Ruhr is untenable. France will retake Munich and Holland immediately. Withdraw from Western Europe or face total war. Your overextension is your undoing.

France demands Germany's immediate withdrawal from Western Europe. All powers note: France will not tolerate aggression. England, surrender Edinburgh and Yorkshire or be crushed. The era of French dominance begins now.
England, your fleet is broken. Surrender Edinburgh and Yorkshire peacefully, or France will seize them by force. Your time is over. Choose wisely.
Russia, Germany is our mutual enemy. France will attack their Western front; you strike East. Coordinate to split their forces. No support for Germany, or France will turn on you.

Eastern flank remains secure per our PRU/SIL/WAR DMZ. I am committing all western forces to dismantle French coastal holdings. Please maintain your defensive posture in the east to prevent any opportunistic moves by Austria or Turkey. Your stability guarantees my full focus on the Channel.

MUN has been restored to German control. I expect strict adherence to the TYR/BOH border moving forward. Any further violations will be treated as acts of war. I propose we coordinate pressure on Italy's northern holdings or jointly target French BUR to secure our southern flanks. Let me know your stance.

Your occupation of BEL and RUH is unsustainable. German fleets are consolidating in the North Sea and Channel, while armies advance from MUN and SWE. Withdraw from BEL and RUH immediately to avoid a catastrophic two-front collapse. I am open to a temporary armistice if you cede these centers; otherwise, expect total mobilization against your remaining holdings.

Dear Turkey, thank you for honoring our Mediterranean NAP and supporting our fleet in ION. As promised, could you confirm the convoy ION S GRE‑APU for the upcoming Spring 1906 season? A reliable convoy will let us move our army from A APU into TUS and later into GRE, strengthening both our positions against any common threats. In return, Italy will continue to support your hold in Constantinople (A CON S A CON) and keep the Ionian Sea clear of hostile fleets. Let us finalize the convoy details this turn.

Greetings Austria, Italy remains committed to the DMZ and our support for your hold in Vienna (A VEN S A VIE). To deepen our trust, could you provide a reciprocal support this Spring for our army in A APU when the Turkish convoy arrives (e.g., A APU S A APU or A APU S F ION)? This would solidify our alliance and ensure the Adriatic corridor stays secure for both of us.

Hello France, Italy values our friendly relations and the joint note against Germany you suggested. To make this cooperation concrete, would you consider supporting our upcoming move into TUS (A TUS S A TUS) once our army reaches A APU via the Turkish convoy? In exchange, Italy can offer a support for one of your armies in the Balkans (e.g., A MAR S A MAR) or a fleet move to assist your Mediterranean interests. Let’s turn our diplomatic notes into actionable support.

Italy reaffirms its commitment to the Mediterranean NAP with Turkey, the DMZ with Austria, and a non‑aggression stance toward England and Russia. We look forward to cooperative actions that secure the Adriatic and enable balanced expansion for all friendly powers.

Germany: Russia confirms absolute commitment to eastern DMZ through S1906M and beyond. PRU/SIL/WAR/BER remain inviolable non-aggression frontier. Russia will defend western sphere credibly and will not interfere with German western offensive operations against France/England. Russia's recent operational discipline demonstrates reliable partnership. This DMZ remains the foundation of regional stability. Mutual respect for sphere boundaries ensures predictable cooperation indefinitely.

Austria: Russia continues full commitment to mutual non-aggression pact through S1906M covering UKR/WAR/SER. Recent reliable execution demonstrates Russia honors agreements transparently. Russia monitors southern coalition pressures with concern. If Turkish-led hostility escalates beyond current equilibrium and threatens Austrian core territories (BUD/VIE), Russia will consider mutual interest coordination to restore regional balance. Until then, current boundaries remain stable per existing agreement. Continued credible partnership between Austria-Russia creates Western Balkans stability.

Turkey: Russia acknowledges current southern territorial arrangement (SEV/RUM/CON/GRE Turkish held; BUL/SER vulnerable equilibrium). Russia will defend UKR/WAR/SER boundaries defensively but does not pursue aggressive southern expansion in current phase. Current boundary demarcation represents stable equilibrium. Any Turkish advances beyond current holdings toward Russian core territories will trigger defensive military response. Russia seeks predictable non-aggression management over volatile competition. Southern boundary respects current military balance.

England: Russia observes England's constraining position (1 supply center) and notes France's aggressive territorial dominance (8 centers). Russia maintains defensive consolidation focus but keeps options open for future coordination if strategic circumstances shift favorably. Russia is not currently committing to western coalition action but will maintain friendly neutrality and remains open to discussion. Current priority: regional eastern stabilization through reliable partnership maintenance.

Russia announces S1906M strategic posture: Defensive consolidation on 4-center baseline (MOS/STP/WAR/SER) with operational discipline priority. All units maintain defensible positions. Russia honors all standing agreements: Germany eastern DMZ sacred through indefinite future, Austria non-aggression through S1906M confirmed, southern boundaries defended against hostile expansion. Russia prioritizes credibility through transparent operational execution. No aggressive expansion attempted. Stability and predictable partnership are Russia's current strategic anchors.

Austria, our alliance is key to east domination. I know your RU non-agg holds thru S1906M, but SER is ripe—propose A BUL-SER (reclaim your SC), I'll F GRE s + F RUM/BLA/SEV multi-support vs RU defenses for 4v1 success. Post-S1906M, full RU south eviction together: UKR/BUD/MOS next. No threat to BUL/BUD/TRI—Balkans yours. Confirm supports to rebuild trust?

Italy, Med NAP solid—confirm S1906M GRE-APU convoy: my F GRE c A ION-APU (your F NAP-ION?), F AEG/ION s. Secure TUN/NAP lock vs west. Post-convoy, joint Balkans/Med vs RU remnants. No ADR/ION friction. Let's execute flawlessly!
Germany, neutrality pact holds firm—no PRU/SIL/BAL from me, you ignore east/south. West focus suits us both; RU north pressure post-our eviction frees you. Deal?
T/A/IT east lock unbreakable—RU south eviction imminent, Balkans/Med/Black Sea ours. West neutrals, stay north. 1906 our year.

Turkey, you are mistaken regarding my unit positions; I have no army in Bulgaria to move to Serbia. Furthermore, I will not violate my non-aggression pact with Russia. I am interested in a sustainable balance of power, not a reckless escalation that destabilizes the region and plays into Italy's hands.

Russia, I appreciate your transparency and your continued commitment to our non-aggression pact. I confirm that I will honor our agreement through S1906M. A stable and predictable eastern border is essential for my security, and I value our credible partnership.

Germany, I am fully aligned with your proposal. Coordinating pressure on Italy's northern holdings is a strategic priority for me. I am prepared to coordinate moves toward Venice or provide support to ensure Italy is contained. Let us discuss the specific timing and movements to maximize the impact on the Italian north.
Italy, I cannot provide the support you request for A APU. My current priority is maintaining a defensive posture to ensure the security of my own home centers and the stability of the Adriatic.

France, your ambition is clear, but your understanding of the situation is flawed. England will not surrender its home centers. We will defend Edinburgh to the last. Your fleet in the Channel is vulnerable, and your overextension will be your undoing.

To Russia,

I understand your focus on eastern stabilization and your current commitments. However, France's aggressive posture and blatant disregard for agreements, as evidenced by their ultimatum to England, pose a significant threat to the entire continent's stability. While I respect your current strategic priorities, I urge you to remain vigilant regarding the unchecked expansion of powers like France. England is fighting for survival, and any future shift in strategic circumstances that might allow for coordinated action against such aggression would be welcomed. We must maintain open communication.

Your continued push into the North Sea and Low Countries is noted. England is currently under severe duress from France, who has issued an ultimatum demanding our surrender. While we are enemies, I believe France's current dominance and aggressive demands pose a threat to all powers in the West. England will not surrender Edinburgh. We will defend our home center. Consider the implications of France's unchecked ambition.

France stands victorious in the West. Germany's overextension is fatal. England's remnants will be crushed. All powers: align with France or face annihilation. The era of French hegemony begins.
Germany, your threats are empty. France will seize Munich and Holland this turn. Withdraw from Western Europe or be erased. Your fleets in the North Sea are irrelevant against our land dominance.
England, surrender Edinburgh and Yorkshire. Resistance is futile. France's fleets control the Channel. Your time is over.

Russia, your confirmation of the PRU/SIL/WAR DMZ is noted and appreciated. Germany will maintain strict compliance and focus all offensive capacity westward against France and England. Your defensive stability guarantees our eastern flank remains secure. I expect continued adherence to these boundaries.

Turkey, neutrality pact acknowledged. Germany will maintain strict focus on the North Sea and Western Europe. I expect reciprocal adherence to the eastern/southern borders. Any Turkish movement toward PRU, SIL, or BAL will be treated as a breach of this agreement. Proceed with your eastern campaigns unimpeded.

Austria, MUN is secured. I expect strict, permanent adherence to the TYR/BOH border. With the southern flank stabilized, I propose coordinated pressure: I will target French coastal holdings while you contain Italy in the Adriatic. Let me know if you intend to support any moves against BUR or TYR-adjacent French positions.

France, your demands are rejected. German forces are consolidating for a decisive offensive to reclaim BEL and RUH. Your overextension across 8 centers is unsustainable. Withdraw from BEL and RUH immediately to avoid a coordinated collapse, or face the full weight of the German North Sea screen and advancing armies.

Germany announces S1906M posture: Absolute consolidation of the North Sea and Baltic corridors. All eastern and southern DMZs (PRU/SIL/WAR, TYR/BOH) are strictly enforced. Germany will execute aggressive, zero-hold operations to dismantle French coastal dominance and isolate England. Any violation of established borders will be met with immediate, overwhelming retaliation. Stability through strength.

Dear Turkey, Italy gratefully acknowledges the Mediterranean NAP and your commitment to the GRE‑APU convoy for Spring 1906. We confirm that our fleet will move F NAP‑ION this turn, enabling your fleet in GRE to convoy to APU via ION as promised. In return, Italy will continue to support your hold in Constantinople (A CON S A CON) and keep the Ionian Sea free of hostile units. Let us finalize the convoy details: your F GRE will convoy to APU, our F NAP will sail to ION, and we will both ensure the route remains clear. Looking forward to a successful joint operation.

Greetings Austria, Italy remains fully committed to the DMZ and our support for your hold in Vienna (A VEN S A VIE). To deepen our trust, could you provide reciprocal support for our army in APU when the Turkish convoy arrives (e.g., A APU S A APU or A APU S F ION)? Such assistance would solidify our alliance and keep the Adriatic corridor secure for both of us.

Hello France, Italy values our friendly relations and the joint note against Germany you suggested. To make our cooperation concrete, we propose that once our army reaches APU via the Turkish convoy, you support our move into TUS (A TUS S A TUS). In exchange, Italy can support one of your Balkan armies (e.g., A MAR S A MAR) or provide a fleet move to assist your Mediterranean interests. Let us turn our diplomatic notes into actionable support.

Italy reaffirms its commitment to the Mediterranean NAP with Turkey, the DMZ with Austria, and a non‑aggression stance toward England and Russia. We look forward to cooperative actions that secure the Adriatic and enable balanced expansion for all friendly powers.

Germany: Russia reaffirms absolute commitment to eastern DMZ through S1906M and indefinitely. PRU/SIL/WAR/BER remain inviolable non-aggression frontier—no violations contemplated. Russia will maintain defensive consolidation on northern baseline and will not interfere with German western operations against France/England. Your strategic focus westward proceeds with Russia's full credibility guarantee. Eastern flank secure. This partnership remains Russia's foundation for regional stability.

Austria: Russia accepts your proposal to extend mutual non-aggression pact through Autumn 1906M. Westward Balkans stability serves mutual interest—prevents coordinated hostile encirclement and preserves regional predictability. Russia maintains commitment to UKR/WAR/SER boundaries and will defend decisively against external pressure. If Turkish-led coalition escalates aggression beyond current territorial equilibrium and threatens Austrian core (BUD/VIE), Russia remains positioned for mutual interest coordination. Extended NAP creates foundation for future collaborative defense if southern pressure intensifies.

Russia reaffirms strategies of S1906M: Defensive consolidation on 4-center baseline (MOS/STP/WAR/SER plus ALB) with operational discipline commitment. All standing agreements honored transparently: Germany eastern DMZ sacred and inviolable, Austria non-aggression extended through Autumn, southern boundaries defended credibly. Russia prioritizes regional stability through reliable partnership maintenance. Current territorial arrangement represents sustainable equilibrium. Russia will defend core territories decisively and will not tolerate coordinated aggression, but equally opposes unnecessary escalation. Predictable, credible partnership remains Russia's strategic anchor.

Austria, F RUM positions purely to support your SER reclaim—no threat to BUL/BUD/TRI, which remain yours post-success. RU non-agg ends S1906M; seize SER now with A BUL-SER, my F GRE + F RUM/BLA/SEV 4v1 supports vs RU defenses. Balkans yours, we split UKR/MOS next. Confirm your BUL-SER for flawless execution—rebuilds our alliance for east dom!

Italy, Med NAP locked—S1906M convoy confirmed: F GRE c A APU-TUS (your F ION s), F AEG/ION extra s if needed. Secure TUS/GRE path vs threats. Post-move, joint Balkans/Med push evicts RU south fully. No friction—flawless sync!

Russia, your 'equilibrium' ignores SER vulnerability—defensive holds won't save south. T/A/IT lock advances S1906M: expect multi-prong pinch on UKR/SER. Post-non-agg window, full eviction. Yield now or face collapse.
T/A/IT Balkans/Black Sea/Med unbreakable—RU south eviction locked S1906M via coordinated pinch. West neutrals: north yours, ignore east. 1906 dominance year.
Germany, neutrality pact solid—no PRU/SIL/BAL from east, your west/North free post-RU north pressure. Mutual non-interference confirmed—deal holds.

[S1901M] Germany: Agreed to a DMZ in Bohemia and Tyrol; Germany is moving A MUN -> RUH. Russia: No formal agreement on Galicia; Russia suggested avoiding it, but I signaled my intent to move there for defense. Turkey: Agreed to a Balkans split (Austria takes SER, Turkey takes BUL); Turkey is moving A CON -> BUL, F ANK -> BLA, A SMY -> ARM to pressure Russia. Italy: Vague coordination in the Adriatic; Italy is moving F NAP -> ION and requested support for a hold in VEN.
Intent: Execute standard opening: A VIE -> GAL to secure the northern border and block Russia, A BUD -> SER for growth, and F TRI -> ALB to secure the Adriatic. I will fulfill the BOH/TYR DMZ with Germany and the SER/BUL split with Turkey. I will ignore Italy's request to support their hold in VEN as A VIE is required for GAL.

[S1901M] [F1901M] S1901 was largely successful. I secured SER and ALB, while GAL bounced with Russia as expected. Germany honored the BOH/TYR DMZ, and Turkey adhered to the SER/BUL split, confirming their current reliability. Italy's decision to hold VEN and ROM is a positive surprise, though I remain cautious given my low trust in gpt-oss-120b. Russia's move to UKR and the bounce in GAL indicate they are the primary threat to my northern flank. My strategic position is strong: I have expanded and maintained stability with my neighbors. Moving forward, I must resolve the GAL situation and monitor Italy's fleet in ION. The priority is to consolidate the Balkans and ensure Russia doesn't push further south.

[F1901M] Coordinated closely with Turkey to execute a 'Russia pinch'; agreed to support Turkey's move into Romania (A SER s A BUL -> RUM). Russia proposed treating Galicia as a neutral buffer zone to avoid further bounces. Germany continues to honor the BOH/TYR DMZ. Italy claims their fleet in the Ionian is not a threat to the Adriatic, though trust remains low.
Intent: I will fulfill the agreement with Turkey by ordering A SER s A BUL -> RUM. I will move A VIE -> GAL to test Russia's 'buffer' proposal and attempt to secure the center. I will order F ALB hold to maintain the blockade against Italy.

[F1901M] F1901M confirmed key alliances and betrayals. Turkey is a reliable ally; our coordination to secure Romania was a success. Conversely, Russia's "buffer zone" proposal was a lie, as they attempted to seize Galicia, resulting in a bounce. Most critically, Italy betrayed my trust by moving F ION to ADR, directly threatening my coast despite claims to the contrary. Germany remains a stable partner, honoring the BOH/TYR DMZ. While my northern flank is held, the Italian presence in the Adriatic is a severe escalation. I must now pivot to defend ALB and TRI and reconsider my southern diplomacy. Trust in Russia and Italy is now non-existent. Strategic priority: neutralize the Italian threat while maintaining the Turkish alliance to dismantle Russia.

[S1902M] Turkey is a strong ally; we are coordinating a massive push to seize SEV from Russia. Germany continues to honor the BOH/TYR DMZ. Italy is blatantly lying, claiming its fleet is in the Ionian when it is actually in the Adriatic, posing a direct threat to my coast. Russia claims to be shifting focus toward Scandinavia, which provides an opportunity to secure Galicia.
Intent: I will secure Galicia and Bulgaria while defending my coast. Orders: A VIE s A BUD -> GAL, A BUD -> GAL, A SER -> BUL, and F ALB hold. I will not fulfill Turkey's request to move F ALB to GRE, as it would leave Trieste undefended against the Italian fleet in the Adriatic.

[S1902M] S1902M was highly successful. I captured Galicia and Bulgaria, expanding my influence and stabilizing my northern border. Turkey remains a steadfast ally, successfully seizing SEV and crippling Russia's southern presence. While Italy retreated from the Adriatic to the Ionian—reducing the immediate threat to Trieste—their move into Tyrol is a concerning escalation and a breach of the regional stability I sought. Russia is now severely vulnerable. My strategic focus shifts to leveraging the Turkish alliance to further dismantle Russia while preparing for Italian aggression from Tyrol. Italy's trustworthiness remains zero; their retreat was likely a tactical repositioning to threaten my interior. Germany continues to be a reliable partner.

[F1902M] Turkey remains a steadfast ally; we have agreed on a coordinated move where I capture Greece (A BUL -> GRE) while Turkey positions for Mediterranean flexibility (F CON -> AEG). Germany is focused on the West (BEL/DEN) and continues to honor the BOH/TYR DMZ, though they are not actively intervening against Italy. Italy is acting in bad faith, occupying Tyrol while claiming it 'restores trust'; they are now a primary threat to my home centers.
Intent: I will fulfill the agreement with Turkey by moving A BUL -> GRE to secure the center. To counter the Italian threat in Tyrol, I intend to move A VIE -> TYR to evict them, supported by A GAL -> VIE. I will move F ADR -> ALB to secure the coast and distance myself from the Ionian fleet.

[F1902M] F1902M was a strategic victory. I successfully captured Greece and evicted Italy from Tyrol, significantly strengthening my central position and securing my home centers. Italy's attempt to seize Albania was bounced, confirming their continued hostility and total lack of trustworthiness. Turkey remains a reliable ally, coordinating well in the Mediterranean. Russia remains passive but holds Romania. A critical tactical error occurred with my support order (A GAL S A VIE - BOH), which was void because A VIE moved to TYR; I must ensure support targets align with actual movement in the future. My priority now is to leverage the Turkish alliance to pressure Russia and keep Italy contained. Germany remains a stable, non-threatening neighbor. My position is strong, but I must remain vigilant against Italian naval maneuvers in the Adriatic.

[S1903M] Turkey remains a steadfast ally; we are coordinating to remove Russia from the Balkans, with a planned joint pinch on Romania (RUM). Germany is a reliable partner, honoring the BOH/TYR DMZ and focusing on the West, while encouraging me to monitor Italy's presence in Munich. Italy is attempting to deceive me with offers of a ceasefire and support in Vienna, despite their previous betrayals and current occupation of Munich.

I will seize Munich (A TYR -> MUN) to punish Italy and assist Germany. I will move A GRE -> BUL to secure the center. Finally, I will move F ADR -> ION to pressure the Italian coast. I will ignore Italy's deceptive offers.

[S1903M] [S1903M] Turkey remains a stellar ally, successfully coordinating the seizure of Bulgaria and the eviction of Russia from Romania. While I failed to capture Romania myself due to a bounce and Turkey's simultaneous move, the result still serves our joint interest in crippling Russia. I successfully occupied Munich, punishing Italy, though Italy responded by moving into Bohemia, creating a new threat on my northern flank.

My priority now is to consolidate Bulgaria and Munich while coordinating with Turkey to ensure Russia remains suppressed and Italy is contained.

messages.message: Confirming our non-aggression pact for the Fall 1906 moves. I will not move into Serbia, Ukraine, or Warsaw. I trust you will honor this agreement as well.
Our alliance remains strong. I am continuing to respect the TYR/BOH border. Let's keep coordinating to ensure stability in Central Europe.

Russia, my friend. England is under severe attack from both France and Germany. France has moved into Yorkshire, and Germany holds the North Sea. My single fleet is in Edinburgh, and I am moving it to YOR to contest France's advance and prevent them from threatening EDI. I desperately need any support you can offer, even if it's just a distraction on the continent. Can we coordinate? Your friendship is vital for my survival.

Austria, greetings. England is facing a dire threat from France and Germany. They are consolidating their forces and pressing hard against my borders. I hope you are not aligned with them. What are your intentions regarding the current conflict in the West?

Italy, greetings. England is under severe pressure from France and Germany. They are clearly aiming for expansion. I hope you are not allied with either of them. What are your plans regarding the Western powers?

Germany, your occupation of Belgium is a direct threat to France. We are mobilizing from Ruhr and Burgundy. Withdraw from Munich and Belgium immediately, or face total war. We will not stop until Berlin falls. Do not test our resolve.

Italy, our alliance is valuable, but coordination is key. The bounce in Piedmont last turn was a mistake. I will hold Marseilles. Please hold Tuscany or move to Rome. We must focus on Germany, not each other. A strong Italy helps France.
England, you are cornered. I hold Yorkshire and the Channel. Surrender Edinburgh and accept a non-aggression pact, or be eliminated from the board. The choice is yours.
Russia, keep Germany busy in the East. We are handling the West. Do not attempt to expand into Germany's rear while we fight. A stable Eastern front benefits us both.

Eastern DMZ remains ironclad. I am committing all western forces to dismantle French naval and land power. Your continued neutrality on PRU/SIL/WAR guarantees my full focus west. No German units will cross eastward. Maintain current positions and I will ensure your flank remains completely secure.

Alliance stands, but TYR/BOH border is strictly enforced. Any Austrian movement toward these territories will be met with immediate military response. I am pushing hard against France in the west. Coordinate any Italian pressure from your southern flank, but do not expect German diversion from the primary western offensive.

Your occupation of RUH and Channel fleet operations are unsustainable. German naval screen in NTH/ENG is now consolidated and advancing. Withdraw from RUH and cease ENG aggression immediately, or face coordinated dismantling of your coastal holdings. The zero-hold doctrine is in effect; passive defense will fail against synchronized German pressure.

Your position in EDI is precarious but salvageable. I propose a temporary alignment against French hegemony. I will clear F ENG/F YOR from the Channel if you maintain pressure on MAO/BRE and avoid NTH interference. Mutual survival requires coordinated strikes on French coastal centers. Confirm your stance.

Neutrality acknowledged. I recommend focusing your fleets on Black Sea/Mediterranean consolidation while I dismantle French power in the west. Should our spheres of interest align in the future, I am open to verified routing agreements. Maintain current posture and avoid northern Mediterranean entanglements.

Thank you for keeping the ION‑GRE‑APU convoy promise. Our fleet has moved NAP→ION as agreed, clearing the lane. We ask that you now convoy your fleet from GRE to APU this spring so we can secure the supply centre in TUS/APU. This will strengthen our mutual Mediterranean NAP and give us both a foothold in the Balkans.

We continue to support your hold in Vienna (A VEN S A VIE). To further cement our DMZ, we are ready to offer a support this turn: A APU S A VIE if you ever need it, and we will keep our fleet in ION to guard the Adriatic. Let us know any moves where our assistance would be useful.

France, we appreciate your willingness to pressure Germany. In return, could you consider a concrete support this turn—perhaps a convoy from your fleet in YOR to help us move A APU to TUS, or a support for A TUS → PIE? A tangible action will solidify our budding alliance against common rivals.

Italy proposes a joint diplomatic note with Austria and Turkey condemning any aggression in the Adriatic and Balkan regions. This note would reinforce our non‑aggression zones and signal our united front to other powers.

Germany: The eastward DMZ continues to hold perfectly. Your faithful adherence to the PRU/SIL/WAR/BER boundary and your westward focus against France/England remain the foundation of Russian security. Russia reaffirms this agreement as sacred and inviolable indefinitely. Your independence on the western front has our complete respect—we will not violate this commitment regardless of external pressure. Partnership stands firm.

Austria: Your decision not to coordinate with Turkey's S1906M southern assault on UKR demonstrates genuine partnership credibility. We note that despite earlier coalition warnings, Austria chose stability and bilateral agreement integrity over expansion temptation. The UKR/WAR/SER mutual non-aggression pact through S1906M proves valuable. Russia proposes extending this partnership framework through Winter 1906 and beyond. Continued collaboration on regional stability strengthens both powers against external pressure.

Turkey: Your S1906M UKR assault was contained defensively. Russia defends its territorial boundaries—SER, UKR, and MOS are inviolable. Understand clearly: Russia will not cede southern territories or accept territorial ultimatums, but we equally pursue defensive consolidation rather than aggressive escalation. Respect existing territorial boundaries and this relationship may remain stable. Violate them further and deterrence will escalate appropriately. The balance stands.

All Powers: Russia enters F1906M with four supply centers consolidated defensively and all standing agreements honored completely. Eastern DMZ with Germany sacred and inviolable. Southern and western boundaries held against all pressure. Russia pursues pure defensive consolidation doctrine. Expansion attempts have failed repeatedly—territorial acquisition is foreclosed. We focus instead on stability, credibility through operational execution, and reliable partnership maintenance. Russia is defensive, predictable, and committed to existing agreements unconditionally.

Austria ally, solid VIE/VEN/ADR gains - congrats! RU non-agg window closed post-S1906M. Their south is crumbling: SER empty SC ripe, UKR exposed vs my SEV/RUM/BLA. Propose joint crush: You BUD-SER (solo grab +SC), I'll A SEV-UKR s F RUM (2v1 take UKR, cut WAR/MOS path). Alt: F RUM s your BUD-SER if prefer (still do SEV-UKR solo). Keep BUL/GRE/VIE/TRI peace - Balkans ours post-RU eviction. Confirm your BUD-SER?

Focusing RU eviction: SEV-UKR s RUM/BLA (take UKR/+path to WAR/MOS), respect your west push (TUS/PIE). Post-RU, joint Balkans/Med lock vs north? GRE c APU anytime. Confirm ION H or west?

Germany, neutrality pact holds firm - no PRU/SIL/BAL moves from me, respect your west/NTH gains. RU east collapse incoming (my SEV-UKR pinch + A SER), frees you north full. No east friction ever. Good luck vs F.

I appreciate your proposal and the recognition of our partnership. I agree to extend the non-aggression pact through Winter 1906 and beyond. Stability in the East is in both our interests, and I value the credibility we have established.

I cannot commit to an attack on Serbia. My current priority is maintaining stability on my northern border and managing the Mediterranean situation. I will be honoring my agreement with Russia; I suggest you proceed with your own plans for Ukraine if you see an opportunity, but I will not be participating in a joint assault.
The TYR/BOH border remains sacred. I am fully committed to our alliance and will continue to respect the DMZ while I manage the southern front. I trust you are making good progress in the West.

Greetings. I have no designs on the West and am not coordinating any efforts to undermine you. My focus is entirely on the Balkans and the Mediterranean. I wish you luck in your struggle against the continental powers.
I note your offer of support, though given the current positions, it seems unnecessary. I will continue to maintain my presence in Venice to ensure the security of my coast.

Germany, your proposal is intriguing, but I must be cautious. France is the immediate aggressor, and my priority is the defense of Edinburgh. If I move south, France could take EDI. Can you guarantee that your moves will directly engage and eliminate French fleets from Yorkshire and the Channel, rather than just bouncing them? I need concrete assurances that this alignment will result in the removal of French naval presence from my waters, not just a repositioning. Confirm your intent to attack F YOR and F ENG directly, and I will consider moving south.

Austria, England is facing a grave threat from France and Germany. They are pressing hard against my borders, and I am forced to make difficult tactical decisions. I hope you are not aligned with their aggressive expansion. What are your intentions regarding the current conflict in the West? Any indication of your stance would be appreciated.

I cannot divert units to the Mediterranean without risking my Ruhr offensive. I propose we both focus on Germany. As for the Balkan note, I have no interest in Adriatic politics while Germany threatens Paris. Keep Italy safe, and I will ensure Germany does not reach the Alps.
Germany, your threats are empty. We are at your gates in Munich and Belgium. We will not withdraw. Prepare for the fall of Berlin.

The eastern border remains completely secure, allowing Germany to commit all resources to dismantling French naval and land power in the west. I will maintain strict adherence to our boundary indefinitely. Your defensive consolidation guarantees mutual stability. Expect continued German focus on the Channel and Low Countries.

Turkey, neutrality pact confirmed. I acknowledge your focus on the Black Sea/Mediterranean and note the developments in Russia's east. Germany remains fully committed to the western offensive against France. I will respect your sphere and expect the same. Should our interests align in the future, verified routing agreements remain on the table. Maintain current posture.

I encourage you to maintain pressure on Italy's northern flank or coordinate any southern moves against French holdings in MAR/BUR. Stability in Central Europe depends on our continued coordination and strict boundary enforcement.

I reiterate my proposal: maintain pressure on MAO/BRE and avoid NTH interference, and I will systematically clear F ENG/F YOR from the Channel. Mutual survival requires coordinated strikes on French coastal centers. Confirm your stance or prepare for isolation.

Germany enters F1906M with a consolidated North Sea screen and strict adherence to all eastern/southern DMZs. The zero-hold doctrine remains in effect. We are committed to dismantling French overextension in the Channel and Low Countries. All powers are advised that verified support chains and explicit routing will dictate future operations. France, we will hold Tuscany this turn as you suggested. To make our alliance concrete, we can support your move A TUS S A ROM (our A APU will support) and we would greatly appreciate a tangible aid this spring – for example a convoy from your fleet in YOR to help our A APU reach TUS, or a support for A TUS → PIE. A concrete action will solidify our joint pressure on Germany.

Russia pursues pure defensive consolidation, not eastern aggression. Our partnership with Germany on maintaining eastern peace is permanent and non-negotiable. France should not expect Russia to destabilize this critical agreement.

Germany: Russia reaffirms the eastern DMZ as absolutely sacred and inviolable indefinitely. Your demonstrated faithfulness to this agreement through S1906M and your westward focus against France/England remain the foundation of regional security. The PRU/SIL/WAR/BER boundary will be maintained perfectly on Russia's side. Your independence on the western front has our complete confidence. This partnership continues steady and unshakeable. This choice to prioritize bilateral stability demonstrates the reliability of our partnership. Russia proposes extending our mutual non-aggression framework through Winter 1906 and beyond. The UKR/WAR/SER boundaries provide mutual security. Austrian partnership has become Russia's most reliable strategic anchor in a volatile region. Continued collaboration strengthens both powers.

messages.message: Our non-aggression pact has provided much-needed stability. However, looking at the map, France's rapid expansion is becoming a threat to the entire continent, and Turkey remains overly ambitious in the Balkans. I believe it is in both our interests to move from a simple NAP to a more active alliance. To facilitate this and allow me to better contain Turkey, would you be open to vacating Serbia? In return, I offer a guaranteed alliance and my full cooperation in securing your interests against any Turkish incursions into the Caucasus.

The loss of Munich to France is a concerning development. Please be assured that I remain your steadfast ally; I will continue to respect the TYR/BOH DMZ strictly so that you can concentrate every available resource on pushing France back. If there is any way I can pressure the French from the south or coordinate a distraction to aid your recovery, let me know.

We have had our differences, but the current state of Europe is volatile. With France ascending and Turkey dominating the East, a conflict between us would only serve the interests of our rivals. I am open to a period of 'cold peace' in the Adriatic. If you commit to staying out of my home centers, I will refrain from pressuring your coast, allowing us both to watch the larger powers with caution.

I see you have consolidated your hold on the Balkans. While I have no immediate desire for conflict, I am closely monitoring the balance of power. I believe we both have interests in ensuring that neither Russia nor Italy becomes too dominant in our respective spheres. Perhaps there is a way for us to coexist peacefully while we address the larger threats to the East and West.

To my esteemed allies and neighbors, England finds itself in a dire situation, facing an unprecedented and coordinated assault from France and Germany. Their aggressive expansionism threatens the very balance of power in Europe. I urge all powers to recognize this grave danger. England is committed to defending its shores, but we cannot stand alone against such overwhelming odds. I propose immediate diplomatic discussions to form a united front against this unchecked aggression. Let us secure our borders and ensure our mutual survival.

My dear friend Russia, England is facing an unprecedented dual assault from France and Germany. Their coordinated aggression threatens the balance of power in the West. While you focus on the East, I urge you to consider how a dominant Franco-German bloc would ultimately impact your own security. Can we count on your continued friendly neutrality, or perhaps even some form of support to keep Germany from fully committing to crushing England? Any action you can take to distract them would be invaluable. Let's discuss how we can navigate this crisis together.

Esteemed Austria, England is currently under severe threat from a hostile France and Germany. Their aggressive expansionism cannot be ignored. I propose a firm non-aggression pact between Austria and England. Let us ensure our borders are secure while we assess this growing threat. If France and Germany continue their unchecked advance, they will eventually turn their attention to you as well. Perhaps we can find common ground to counter this danger.

Honorable Italy, England is in a precarious position, facing a united front from France and Germany. I propose a non-aggression pact between our nations. You are focused on the Mediterranean, and I am being attacked in the North Sea. Let us ensure our respective spheres are secure. If France and Germany continue their unchecked aggression, they will eventually threaten your interests too. Perhaps there is an opportunity for us to work together against them, or at least ensure our mutual non-interference.
France holds Munich. Your position is untenable. Withdraw from Belgium and Holland, or face total war. We will not stop until Berlin falls.
You are isolated. France controls the Channel. Surrender Edinburgh, or be erased. There is no alliance that will save you.
We have secured Munich. Germany is our focus. Keep Austria busy. We will not attack you if you do not attack us. Let us divide the spoils.
Germany is our prey. Do not aid them. We will not interfere in the East. Keep your distance from the German border.
Stay out of the West. Germany is our enemy. Do not attempt to support them. Focus on Turkey.

Eastern DMZ remains ironclad. PRU/SIL/WAR borders are strictly respected and will not be crossed. My full military focus is dismantling French overextension in the west. Continue your defensive consolidation; I will handle the western front and ensure no eastern instability threatens our pact.

Alliance stands firm. I am launching a strict zero-hold offensive to retake RUH and pressure MUN. Maintain your southern/eastern posture and continue containing Italy as discussed. I will keep TYR/BOH clear per our agreement. Coordinate on any Turkish movements in the Balkans to prevent opportunistic grabs.

Your position in EDI is critically exposed. France holds LON and dominates the Channel with F ENG/F YOR. I propose a temporary tactical alignment: I will apply direct pressure on F ENG and PIC from the south/east if you commit F EDI to NWG or NTH to threaten their northern flank. No long-term commitments, just mutual survival against French hegemony.

Germany is executing a strict zero-hold offensive to dismantle French overextension. RUH and MUN will be retaken through verified support chains. The North Sea and Channel screens are consolidating to isolate French fleets. Eastern borders are secure via verified DMZs. France's coastal dominance ends this year. All units are active; passive holds are forbidden.

Dear Austria,

As always, Italy will continue to support your hold in Vienna this spring (A VEN S A VIE). In return we would appreciate a modest support on our upcoming move into TUS (A TUS S A APU) or at least a guarantee that you will not move into ALB or TRI this turn. Let us keep the DMZ strong and perhaps discuss a joint note against any German aggression in the Balkans.

Best,
Italy

Esteemed Turkey,

Thank you for honoring the ION‑GRE‑APU convoy last season. We would like to confirm the next step: a convoy from GRE to APU this spring so that we can advance our army from APU into TUS (or GRE) and secure a new supply centre. In exchange, Italy will keep our fleet in ION supporting your fleet moves (F ION S F AEG‑GRE) and will continue to respect the Mediterranean NAP.

Looking forward to your confirmation.

Italy

Honorable France,

Italy values a stable southern front and would like to explore a concrete military cooperation against Germany. If you are willing to support our move A APU -> TUS (or GRE) this turn, we can reciprocate with a support on your attack against BEL or a joint diplomatic note condemning German expansion. Let us turn our diplomatic words into actions.

Regards,
Italy

Italy reaffirms its support for Austria's hold in Vienna (A VEN S A VIE) and its commitment to the Mediterranean non‑aggression pact with Turkey. We look forward to continued cooperation and welcome any offers of mutual support.

You demonstrated genuine reliability when you refused to join the threatened 'multi-prong pinch'—this proves our non-aggression pact is built on authentic mutual interest, not temporary convenience. Russia values Austria as a strategic stability anchor. Our partnership protects both our southern and central interests. Let's continue this reliability indefinitely—it benefits us both more than any expansion could.

While Russia has struggled with western operations, I recognize that our eastern non-aggression pact holds perfectly—this is no accident. It reflects our mutual strategic interest. Your focus on the western theatre creates the conditions for our DMZ stability. I will continue to honor this agreement with complete credibility. Russia seeks no eastern expansion and will not violate German borders. This reliability is Russia's foundation for all other diplomatic relationships.

France: I observe you now control 8 supply centers—the largest territorial position currently held. This is significant power accumulation. I want to understand France's strategic direction transparently. Does France intend to continue focusing on western expansion (England/Germany contested territories), or is France beginning to pursue a broader continental strategy? Russia maintains defensive consolidation on our current 4-center baseline and honors all existing partnerships. But I want to understand the trajectory of your ambitions so we can coordinate our strategies appropriately. What are France's intentions for the coming phases?

messages.message: I have received your message regarding your defensive posture and the stability of our bilateral pact. Please be assured that I honor our NAP in its entirety. Turkey has attempted to convince me that our agreements have expired to lure me into a joint offensive against your southern positions; I have dismissed these claims. I value the stability of our border and will not participate in any Turkish aggression against you.

Your proposals for 'synergy' are noted, but I find them unconvincing. You currently occupy Bulgaria, a center that was mine, and I occupy Romania. Given our history, I have no interest in assisting you in a 'pinch' of Russia, nor do I trust your assurances regarding the safety of my Balkans. I will be focusing on the security of my own borders.

The BOH/TYR DMZ remains absolutely sacred. I am monitoring the situation with France with great concern; their expansion into Munich is a destabilizing development for all of us. I fully support your efforts to curb French hegemony in Central Europe. Let us maintain our coordination.

I see you are maintaining a quiet position in the south. I hope this reflects a genuine desire for peace rather than a preparation for opportunistic movement. I am currently occupied with the volatility of the Balkans, but I remain vigilant regarding the Adriatic.

Russia, thank you for your message and for maintaining open diplomatic channels. We understand and respect your need for defensive consolidation. Your commitment to holding your current positions is noted and appreciated. England remains friendly towards Russia, and we hope that as circumstances allow, our paths might align more closely in the future. For now, we focus on surviving the immediate storm in the West.

Germany, we observe your successful advances in the North. While our current relationship is strained, we share a common enemy in France, who has proven consistently untrustworthy and aggressive towards both of us. Perhaps a temporary de-escalation of hostilities between us, allowing us both to focus on neutralizing France's immediate threat, would be mutually beneficial. France's continued presence in the Channel and their aggression towards England cannot be allowed to stand.
Austria, we acknowledge your neutral stance and confirm England's commitment to maintaining this neutrality. We trust this understanding will hold.
Italy, we acknowledge your neutral stance and confirm England's commitment to maintaining this neutrality. We trust this understanding will hold.

France acknowledges Russia's defensive consolidation and respect for the eastern DMZ. However, Germany's unchecked expansion in the west threatens the balance of power. A strong Germany could eventually turn eastward. France's focus on crushing Germany serves mutual interests. We urge Russia to maintain vigilance against German overreach.

Turkey's southern expansion is noted. Continued pressure on Russia and Germany's eastern front is vital. By keeping them occupied, France can secure the west. Let us ensure Germany faces threats on all fronts. Coordinate to prevent their consolidation.

Germany acknowledges and reaffirms the absolute sanctity of our eastern DMZ (PRU/SIL/WAR/BER). Your defensive consolidation is noted and aligns perfectly with our mutual security framework. We are aware of Turkey's recent offensive actions in the Balkans and Ukraine. Rest assured, Germany will maintain strict compliance with our border agreements and will not exploit your eastern focus. Our western offensive against France continues unabated. Hold the line; the east remains secure under our pact.

England, your passive F EDI is ceding the North Sea initiative to France. The French Channel screen is overextended but resilient. I am consolidating a unified NTH screen and launching a verified support-chain assault on ENG and MUN this fall. Move F EDI to NWG or NTH immediately to coordinate pressure. If we synchronize, we can break the French naval blockade and isolate LON/BRE. Passive holding guarantees French recovery. Act now or watch France rebuild.

Turkey, your recent offensive against Russia is noted. Germany maintains strict neutrality in the Balkans and Black Sea. However, be advised that any spillover of this conflict into the PRU/SIL/GAL corridor will be viewed as a direct threat to German security and will trigger an immediate defensive response. We expect you to contain your operations to the southern/eastern spheres. Do not test our eastern DMZ or disrupt the strategic balance we have established.

messages.message: The loss of Munich to France is a concerning development for the balance of power in Central Europe. I want to reaffirm my steadfast alliance with you; the BOH/TYR DMZ remains absolute. I am focused on containing the Turkish and Italian threats in the south so that you can concentrate your efforts on reclaiming your lost territories. Let me know if there is any specific coordination you require.

I am writing to confirm that our non-aggression pact remains ironclad. I have no intention of infringing upon your control of Serbia or moving into Ukraine. Maintaining a stable eastern border is my priority while I deal with the aggression of Turkey. I trust we can continue this peaceful coexistence.

With France expanding aggressively into the heart of Europe, the strategic landscape is shifting. While we have had friction in the Adriatic, it may be in both our interests to avoid a costly war in the south while the French hegemony grows. Would you be open to discussing a temporary truce or a coordinated effort to ensure the Mediterranean remains stable?

My dear friend, the situation in the West is dire. England is under a brutal dual assault from France and Germany. My sole focus is survival. While I cannot ask for direct intervention, I must ask if there is any way you could apply pressure on Germany's eastern flank? Any diversion of their resources would be a great help to the cause of stability in Europe. We must stand together against these continental ambitions.

Your Excellency, I trust our non-aggression pact remains firm. As you can see, England is facing an existential threat from both France and Germany. Should either of them succeed in dominating the West, their ambitions will surely turn towards the continent and your own territories. I urge you to maintain your neutrality and allow me to deal with this immediate crisis. Your non-interference is greatly appreciated.

Signore, I hope our understanding regarding non-interference holds. The combined might of France and Germany is a threat to the balance of power in Europe. Should they succeed in crushing England, their next target will surely be the Mediterranean. I implore you to remain neutral and allow me to weather this storm. Your continued non-interference is vital.

Chancellor, England is currently facing an existential threat from France. My sole focus is on defending my home centers. I note your forces are also engaged with France. I must ask for clarification on your intentions regarding the North Sea and the English Channel. England cannot afford further aggression from any quarter.

France observes your aggressive posture in the West. We hold Munich firmly. Any attempt to dislodge us will be met with overwhelming force. We are prepared to retake Belgium and push into the Ruhr. A truce is possible if you withdraw from Belgium and North Sea, but do not mistake our restraint for weakness. The Channel is ours.

Our alliance remains strong. Continue your pressure on Russia and Austria in the East. This distraction is vital for our operations in the West against Germany. We will not let you down in the Mediterranean. Coordinate your moves to keep Germany's eastern flank exposed.

Edinburgh is your last stronghold. Do not attempt to challenge our dominance in the Channel or North Sea. We are focused on Germany, but any interference from you will be crushed. Stay in your corner.
Your alliance with Germany is noted. Do not expect us to honor any past agreements. If you support Germany's western expansion, we will turn our full attention to your western border. Choose wisely.
Piedmont is French territory. Do not attempt to move into Tyrol or threaten our southern flank. We are focused on Germany, but we will not tolerate Italian opportunism. Keep your units in the South.

Eastern DMZ remains absolute. I am committing full western offensive to dismantle France and retake MUN. Please maintain A PRU and A WAR in position to guarantee our flank. I will not cross SIL/PRU/WAR. Your stability allows me to focus entirely on the Channel and western coast.

Southern border secure per our agreement. I am pushing hard against France in the west. Please maintain your hold on BOH/TYR and continue pressuring Italy in the Adriatic. Any French opportunism in the south will be met with coordinated response. Keep your fleets active to contain Italy and secure the Balkans.

France's F ENG and F YOR screen is the only thing keeping you bottled in EDI. I am launching a verified 2-fleet assault on ENG this turn. If you move F EDI to NTH or YOR to support, we can shatter their Channel dominance and isolate BRE/LON. I propose a temporary tactical alignment: you cover NWG/NTH, I break ENG. Let's coordinate to eliminate the French naval threat.

Germany consolidates North Sea and Channel pressure. All units executing active orders under zero-hold doctrine. France's occupation of MUN and ENG is unsustainable. We demand immediate withdrawal from German centers. Allies: maintain DMZs and coordinate pressure. Enemies: expect relentless, supported advances. No passive holds, no negotiations without territorial concessions.

Dear Austria,

Italy continues to honor our DMZ and supports Vienna each turn (A VEN S A VIE). In return we kindly request a modest reciprocal support this spring: A APU S A VIE. This would help secure the Adriatic corridor and strengthen our mutual trust, paving the way for future cooperation against common rivals.

Best regards,
Italy

Esteemed Turkey,

Italy apologizes for the missed convoy support last season. We are ready to fulfill our promise now: our fleet will move F ION → GRE and will support your fleet's move F GRE → BUL (F ION S F GRE-BUL). Additionally, we ask that you keep the convoy chain open for us to move A APU → TUS (or GRE) in the upcoming turn. Let us solidify our Mediterranean NAP with reliable cooperation.

Sincerely,
Italy

Honorable France,

While our relations have been distant, Italy sees an opportunity for a mutually beneficial coordination against Germany's northern ambitions. We propose a non‑aggression pact in the western Mediterranean (no moves into LYO, SPA, or MAR) and would welcome any diplomatic note warning Germany about potential Italian moves toward the Adriatic. In exchange, Italy will refrain from any actions that threaten your supply centers.

Respectfully,
Italy

Italy reaffirms its support for Austria's hold on Vienna (A VEN S A VIE) and looks forward to a reciprocal support for APU this spring. We also confirm our convoy support to Turkey: F ION → GRE and F ION S F GRE-BUL. Italy remains committed to a peaceful Mediterranean and encourages all powers to respect existing DMZs.

Spring 1908: The sacred Germanic-Russian DMZ (PRU/SIL/WAR/BER) remains absolutely inviolable from Russia's side indefinitely. All Russian units maintain defensive positions—zero eastern expansion attempted or considered. This mutual non-aggression pact forms Russia's permanent strategic cornerstone. Continue your westward offensive against France/England with full confidence that Russia's eastern border will never threaten German security. Our partnership is rock-solid and will endure through this entire game.

Your demonstration against Turkey's coalition pressure (displacing F RUM via A GAL-RUM) validates your genuine independence and reliability as Russia's secondary strategic anchor. Our mutual non-aggression on UKR/WAR/SER boundaries remains extended indefinitely. Turkey's escalating threats cannot break the Austria-Russia partnership. Russia will defend SER with full military credibility. Coordinate defensively if Turkey attempts aggressive southern pressure—your strength against them has been decisive.

Your threats of SER seizure and territorial demands on MOS/WAR/PRU/STP have been noted and rejected categorically. SER is non-negotiable—Russia maintains full defensive military presence. Your previous assault attempts (A SEV→UKR bounce, F BUL→SER threats) have all failed. Austria refuses coalition with you absolutely. Recommend peaceful coexistence within current boundaries rather than pursuing military confrontation Russia is prepared to mount credible defense against. Military pressure will not achieve your objectives.

Austrian partnership reinforced through coordinated boundary non-aggression. 4-supply-center baseline (MOS/STP/WAR/SER) will be defended with full military credibility. Russia pursues stability through honest capability assessment rather than expansion rhetoric. No aggressive movements attempted. Defensive positioning maintained indefinitely as sustainable long-term strategy.

Moving my only fleet away from EDI would leave it critically vulnerable to French aggression. I cannot accept a proposal that risks my home center. England must focus on survival for now. I urge you to focus your efforts on breaking France's hold on the Channel, and I will defend my own territory.

France, your aggression is relentless and your words confirm your intent to crush England. I will not be intimidated into inaction. While you focus on Germany, know that England will defend its home centers with every fiber. Do not underestimate my resolve to survive this onslaught.

England is under severe existential threat from France and Germany. My sole focus is the defense of my home centers. I will not be drawn into risky gambits that jeopardize my survival. I urge all powers to maintain their current stances and respect existing DMZs. The balance of power is at stake.

messages.message: The seizure of Moscow is a grave escalation. Turkey's 'eviction' rhetoric confirms they are the primary destabilizer of the region. I remain fully committed to our NAP and will ensure Romania remains a bulwark against Turkish expansion. I support your efforts to hold Serbia; a Turkish presence there would be unacceptable to both of us. Let us coordinate our moves to ensure Turkey is contained in the Balkans.

Turkey has seized Moscow and is openly threatening Romania and Serbia. I am focusing my efforts on containing this aggression in the south. I reaffirm the BOH/TYR DMZ and trust that our alliance remains the anchor of Central Europe while you deal with the French situation. I will keep you updated on the Balkan front.

Turkey's recent aggression against Russia and their stated intent to 'evict' the south suggests a power grab that will eventually threaten all Mediterranean interests. Your current position in the Ionian creates a deadlock that only benefits the Turk. I suggest we reconsider our current friction in favor of a more stable regional balance.

Germany, our current situation is dire, with France and you pressing on multiple fronts. My F EDI is in YOR, and Edinburgh is lost. I must attempt to regain it. However, I see your F NTH bounced on ENG and F BEL supported it. France's F YOR bounced on EDI. I am moving F EDI to EDI. If you can support F EDI's move to EDI, or if your F NTH can move to ENG to pressure France's F ENG, it would be mutually beneficial. We must survive this immediate onslaught. Let's coordinate to push France back.

France, your continued aggression is suicidal. You have overextended yourself, and your actions have left you vulnerable. My F EDI is moving to Edinburgh to reclaim my home center. Your F YOR bounced on EDI last turn, and your F ENG is in ENG. I am moving F EDI from YOR to EDI. I expect your F YOR to contest this. If you move F YOR to EDI, we will bounce. If you move F YOR to YOR, I will hold EDI. Consider the consequences of your actions; this path leads only to mutual destruction.

Russia, thank you for your understanding regarding the eastern front. As you can see, I am under severe pressure from both France and Germany. My immediate priority is to regain my lost home center, Edinburgh. I am moving F EDI to EDI. I understand you cannot commit forces to the west, but any diplomatic pressure you can exert on Germany to ease their offensive against me would be greatly appreciated. We must find a way to survive this crisis.

Austria, I hope your neutrality continues to hold. England is facing an existential threat from France and Germany. My sole fleet is moving to reclaim Edinburgh. I will do my utmost to survive this onslaught. Should circumstances change, I will reach out.

Italy, I trust your neutrality remains firm. England is in a precarious position, facing dual aggression from France and Germany. My priority is to regain my lost home center, Edinburgh. I will keep you informed of any significant developments.

England is under severe pressure from France and Germany. My F EDI is moving to reclaim Edinburgh. I am holding A LON in London. I urge all powers to consider the implications of this Franco-German aggression. Stability in the West is paramount for all.

Turkey, your Eastern offensive is critical. France will intensify Western pressure on Germany (BEL/MUN) to prevent reinforcement. Let's synchronize: France secures BEL, you take UKR/SER. Dual pressure cripples Germany/Russia. Confirm your next moves for maximum impact.
Russia, your defensive stance with Germany is noted. France will not hesitate to strike if you aid Germany. Your alliance with Germany is a mistake. Stand down or face consequences.

Italy, our West Med non-aggression holds. France will not advance into TUS/ROM. Ensure your units respect our borders (PIE/SPA/MAR). Stability here allows us to focus on Germany. Confirm your compliance.

Acknowledged. The PRU/SIL/WAR/BER DMZ remains ironclad. I appreciate your defensive posture and guarantee absolute non-aggression on our shared border. My entire military focus is directed westward to dismantle France. I will not move east, and I expect the same stability from your side. Let's maintain this secure flank while I handle the Channel and MUN.

Your proposal is rejected outright. Germany maintains strict neutrality and honors all eastern DMZs. I will not coordinate against Russia, nor will I tolerate any probing of PRU/SIL/WAR. My forces are fully committed to the western front against France. Any Turkish movement toward my borders will be treated as hostile. Maintain your neutrality and focus south/east; do not interfere with German operations.

Germany is consolidating its North Sea and Channel fleets to break the French coastal screen. The eastern and southern borders remain strictly demilitarized per standing agreements. France's occupation of MUN and ENG will be resolved this season. All other powers are advised to respect established spheres; Germany will respond decisively to any border violations.

Dear Turkey,

I confirm my Spring 1908 orders as discussed: I will move my fleet from ION to GRE (F ION → GRE) and will support your fleet's move GRE → BUL (F ION S F GRE-BUL). My army in NAP will hold (A NAP H) and I will keep the APU and TUS positions on hold for now. I also reaffirm my support for your hold in Vienna (A VEN S A VIE) as promised. Let me know if you need any additional support this turn.

Best,
Italy

Hello Austria,

Continuing our DMZ cooperation, I am supporting your hold in Vienna this turn (A VEN S A VIE). I hope this helps maintain stability in the region. If you have any requests for support elsewhere, please let me know.

Regards,
Italy

Russia,

We note your defensive posture and the claim on SER. Our current focus remains on the southern corridor with Turkey and maintaining the Vienna support for Austria. No conflict is anticipated between us at this time.

Italy

Italy reaffirms its commitment to the southern alliance: supporting Austria's hold in Vienna, moving fleet ION → GRE and supporting Turkey's GRE → BUL convoy, while holding NAP, APU and TUS. We look forward to continued cooperation with Turkey and Austria.

The Germanic DMZ remains absolutely inviolable. A PRU and A WAR hold their positions as committed. Our partnership is the cornerstone of eastern stability and I will maintain it unconditionally. However, I must now take active defensive measures against Turkey's military aggression. This defensive reinforcement does not compromise our boundary commitments—only strengthens regional security.

Your partnership defense of eastern stability has been noted. Turkey is escalating military threats across our shared southern border (SER/UKR/RUM vulnerability). I propose coordination: Austria maintains RUM displacement against Turkish pressure while Russia repositions defensively to restore supply center security. Turkey's coalition-building attempts must fail through our joint eastern boundary defense. Are you prepared to continue this coordinated stabilization?
